input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Meets or exceeds the preferred position: professional/workmanlike services warranty, 90-day Deliverable conformance plus full-term hosted-Services conformance, compliance with law and no-malicious-code warranties, and a re-perform/repair/replace-then-refund remedy (§19.4). The disclaimer in §19.5 expressly does not limit the express warranties.
